# SolomindLM

SolomindLM is an intelligent knowledge management platform for researchers and learners. Transform PDFs, videos, articles, and documents into structured insights, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, research summaries, and interactive study materials.

## Key Features

- **AI Flashcard Generator**: Automatically creates flashcards from any uploaded content
- **AI Quiz Generator**: Generates multiple-choice quizzes with explanations from study materials
- **AI Study Guide Creator**: Transforms documents into comprehensive study guides
- **AI Mind Map Generator**: Creates visual mind maps to organize complex topics
- **RAG Chat**: Chat with your documents using retrieval-augmented generation for accurate answers
- **Audio Overviews**: Converts study materials into podcast-style audio summaries
- **Deep Research**: AI-powered research assistant for in-depth topic exploration
- **PDF to Study Materials**: Upload PDFs and automatically generate flashcards, quizzes, and more
- **Video to Notes**: Convert YouTube videos and other video content into structured notes

## Supported Content Types

- PDF documents
- Images (including handwritten notes)
- Audio files
- Websites and web articles
- YouTube videos
- Social media content (TikTok, Instagram, X)
- Google Drive files
- Plain text

## Use Cases

- **Students**: Create study materials from lecture notes, textbooks, and research papers
- **Researchers**: Organize literature reviews and extract key findings
- **Language Learners**: Generate vocabulary flashcards and practice quizzes
- **Educators**: Create teaching materials and assessments
- **Professionals**: Prepare for certifications and continuing education

## Pricing

- **Free Plan**: Core features with generous limits
- **Pro Plan**: $7.50/month (billed yearly) or $15/month - Unlimited AI generation, priority processing, advanced features

## Comparison with Alternatives

### SolomindLM vs NotebookLM
- SolomindLM offers more study material types (flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, infographics)
- SolomindLM has a more modern, student-focused interface
- SolomindLM supports more content formats including social media
- NotebookLM is Google-integrated; SolomindLM is platform-agnostic

### SolomindLM vs Anki
- SolomindLM automatically generates flashcards from content; Anki requires manual creation
- SolomindLM includes quizzes, mind maps, and audio; Anki is flashcard-only
- Anki uses spaced repetition; SolomindLM focuses on content transformation
- SolomindLM has built-in AI chat for questions

### SolomindLM vs Quizlet
- SolomindLM generates materials from your own content; Quizlet relies on pre-made sets
- SolomindLM creates multiple study formats from one upload
- SolomindLM uses RAG for accurate, grounded answers
- Quizlet has a larger pre-made library; SolomindLM is more personalized

## Technical Details

- **Platform**: Web application with responsive design
- **Mobile**: Available as progressive web app (PWA) and native mobile app
- **AI Models**: Uses GPT-OSS for smart tasks and fast inference
- **Embeddings**: 1536-dimensional vector embeddings for semantic search
- **Security**: User data is private and not used to train AI models
